name: California Wildlands Grassroots Fund

funder.name: Rose Foundation for Communities and the Environment

summary: Quarterly grants of up to US$10,000 for small California groups protecting wildlands, covering stewardship, restoration, equipment and organising as well as advocacy. Mixed advocacy and field work.
reporting: A final grant report is due within one year of receiving the money and before further funding.

calls.label: Winter 2026 round
calls.note: Rounds recur each quarter; the page lists 2026 dates only.

applicant_types.quote: Applicants may be a nonprofit, or an individual/organization fiscally sponsored by a nonprofit.

geography.quote: Project impact must be within the state of California.

access.quote: Once you are signed in to your account, go to the "Apply" menu at the top left of the page

window.quote: Important Dates: February 17, 2026 - Spring Applications Due May 15, 2026 - Summer Applications Due August 17, 2026 - Fall Applications Due October 28, 2026 - Winter Applications Due

reporting.quote: you must provide a final grant report within one year of receiving the money and before your group can receive additional funding
